content:
The HWPX generation failed because the output XML did not contain the correctly formatted age string '1990-11-02 (35세)'.
While the script successfully generated section0.xml, it failed the assertion in test_outputs.py:30. The verifier expected the patient's birthdate and age to be concatenated in a specific format, but the string '1990-11-02 (35세)' was missing from the XML content. Avoid omitting the calculated age suffix when mapping JSON data to the HWPX template tags.
